name: LEDshows Connector
author: LEDshows.nl / Kingshome0317
description: Connect your show to LEDshows.nl with song selection, configurable requests and synchronized listening.

privacy.summary: When enabled, shares selected songs and playback timing with LEDshows.nl. Optional listening publishes the selected source audio to your show page.

sends.what: Show ID, private pairing token over HTTPS, selected song names and IDs, playback position, request settings and acknowledgements. When listening is enabled, the selected source audio files (max 50 MB each).
sends.why: Display this show and process explicitly permitted visitor song requests.

collects.what: Transient song request ID and selected song ID, with no visitor identity

systemChanges.what: Runs one Python connector as the fpp user through FPP startup/shutdown hooks; no systemd service or listening port.

privacy.other: Outbound HTTPS only. The operator enables the connector and chooses individual media files. Listening copies the selected source audio to private storage on kaart.ledshows.nl; public show visitors can play it while listening remains enabled. Playback follows FPP position, with visitor timing adjustment; it is not a capture of the physical audio output and has no microphone fingerprinting. Requests can run next, after the show, or interrupt immediately, as selected by the operator. The connector manages two reserved request programs through FPP APIs. No arbitrary remote commands or system configuration changes.
